# Kolkata Startup Map

Kolkata Startup Map is an interactive directory of startups, companies, locations and hiring opportunities across Kolkata and the surrounding startup ecosystem.

## Main resource
- https://heysiddhartha.github.io/kolkata-startup-map/

## Public data and discovery
- Public data guide: https://heysiddhartha.github.io/kolkata-startup-map/ai-data.html
- Companies dataset (JSON): https://heysiddhartha.github.io/kolkata-startup-map/data/companies.json
- Jobs dataset (JSON): https://heysiddhartha.github.io/kolkata-startup-map/data/jobs.json
- XML sitemap: https://heysiddhartha.github.io/kolkata-startup-map/sitemap.xml
- Robots policy: https://heysiddhartha.github.io/kolkata-startup-map/robots.txt

## What the site contains
- Kolkata startup profiles
- Startup locations and sectors
- Hiring and job signals
- Startup discovery and ecosystem filters

## Data quality
The datasets are static snapshots generated during deployment. Verify company details and hiring status against linked original sources before acting on them. A missing job listing does not prove that a company is not hiring.
